versions.subject: add powershell_keylogging.yml
versions.detection:
selection_id:
    EventID: 4104
selection_basic:
    ScriptBlockText|contains: 'Get-Keystrokes'    
selection_high: # want to run in backgroud and keybord
    ScriptBlockText|contains|all:
        - 'Get-ProcAddress user32.dll GetAsyncKeyState'
        - 'Get-ProcAddress user32.dll GetForegroundWindow'
condition: selection_id and (selection_basic or selection_high)
versions.spl: EventID=4104 ScriptBlockText="*Get-Keystrokes*" OR (ScriptBlockText="*Get-ProcAddress user32.dll GetAsyncKeyState*" ScriptBlockText="*Get-ProcAddress user32.dll GetForegroundWindow*")
